newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech NPF bill auction yield set at 12.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech NPF bill auction yield set at 12.5 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank on Tuesday set a Dutch auction offering 2.5 billion crowns in 22-week National Property Fund (NPF) bills to be held on Friday, the central bank said.
It set a limit price on bids for the bills each with a one million crown nominal value of 949,240 crowns, implying a gross yield of 12.5 percent.
The NPF is the state agency responsible for managing government shares in Czech companies.
